title: Rental-Phase Share of the Medicaid Oxygen Rate (Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility)
content:
**Clause.** In an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility crossover, the rental-phase share of the Medicaid monthly rate follows the rental month number of the Home Oxygen Therapy line being crossed over, as shown on that claim line:

- months from 25 on take 90 percent of the rate;
- months from 13 up to 24 take 96 percent;
- earlier months (1 to 12) take the whole rate.

| Rental month number on the line | Rental-phase share |
|---|---|
| 1 to 12 | 100 percent |
| 13 to 24 | 96 percent |
| 25 and later | 90 percent |

The share is applied to the monthly rate before the rate is rounded to the cent.

**Edges (hypothetical rate before rounding, 200.00).** Month 12: 200.00. Month 13: 192.00. Month 24: 192.00. Month 25: 180.00.
